# Screenshot Requests — one-pass pack

Goal: capture the current authorized lab configuration with enough coverage for later testing and reporting.

## General capture rules
- Use only bugbountyfoto6.files.com.
- Prefer full-window screenshots.
- Keep the browser address bar visible when it proves which page/account/context is being shown.
- Do not capture passwords, cookies, API keys, bearer tokens, session tokens, MFA seeds, recovery codes, or Authorization headers.
- Do not open Ask AI.
- If a page exposes a newly generated secret once, do NOT screenshot that secret.
- Put each screenshot in the matching folder using the suggested filename.

## 01_site_overview
[ ] S01_site_root.png
    Admin logged in, root Files page visible; enough UI to show the [BUGBOUNTY] trial name.

[ ] S02_users_list.png
    Admin -> Users list, showing tetst1 exists and is a Standard User.

[ ] S03_site_nav.png
    Admin page showing the major navigation areas available (Users / Settings / Files / Share Links if present).

    Must show public-b = Full Access and that no private-a permission is present.

[ ] S08_tetst1_auth_overview_NO_SECRETS.png
